# ZanziBiz

> ZanziBiz (zanzibiz.com) is the small-business directory for Zanzibar, Tanzania, with a travel guide for visitors and residents. Local businesses list themselves for free; each listing has contact details, WhatsApp, location and opening hours.

## Directory

- [All businesses](https://zanzibiz.com/directory): browse every listed business
- [Accommodation](https://zanzibiz.com/directory/accommodation): hotels, guesthouses and rentals
- [Activities and tours](https://zanzibiz.com/directory/activities): tours, excursions and things to do
- [Business and services](https://zanzibiz.com/directory/business): local shops, trades and professional services
- [Automotive](https://zanzibiz.com/directory/automotive): car hire, scooters, taxis and repairs
- [Events](https://zanzibiz.com/directory/events): what's on in Zanzibar
- [Jobs](https://zanzibiz.com/directory/jobs): jobs in Zanzibar

Each business has its own page at https://zanzibiz.com/business/{name}.

## Travel guide

- [Travel guide](https://zanzibiz.com/travel-guide): practical guides to Zanzibar
- [Flights to Zanzibar](https://zanzibiz.com/travel-guide/flights-to-zanzibar)
- [Where to stay](https://zanzibiz.com/travel-guide/where-to-stay)
- [Hotels](https://zanzibiz.com/travel-guide/hotels)
- [Tours](https://zanzibiz.com/travel-guide/tours)
- [Airport transfers](https://zanzibiz.com/travel-guide/airport-transfers)
